 Verdict: satisfied

 Comments: No week's pace per kilometer is more than 2.9 minutes/km, so each week's implied finish time will be less than 56.5 minutes, and their deviations from the target time of 56.4 minutes should all be less than 1 minute, which in seconds is 60. Clearly the plan satisfies this constraint because no single day can have a race pace faster than 2.9 min/km; hence its finish time is too early to violate the constraint on any one day.
